query.name: ca.myblueprint.dem.shsmrecord
query.sql: WITH cfg AS ( SELECT '' AS school_ids ,'%SHSM%' AS program_name_pattern ,1 AS exclude_brd_res_9 ,0 AS exclude_future_entries ,'%SHSM' AS cert_group_pattern FROM dual ) SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(st.STUDENT_NUMBER) AS a_StudentID ,'1' AS b_RecordType ,TO_CHAR(sc.DATE_COMPLETED, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS c_DateCompleted ,TRIM(TRANSLATE(pcc.DESCRIPTION, '|' || CHR(9) || CHR(10) || CHR(13), ' ')) AS d_Name ,pcc.CODE AS e_CertificationID ,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1)) AS f_CLA ,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1)) AS g_Comments ,TO_CHAR(sc.CERTIFICATION_HOURS) AS h_Hours ,TO_CHAR(st.SCHOOLID) AS i_SchoolCode FROM STUDENTS st LEFT JOIN cfg ON 1=1 INNER JOIN S_ON_STU_SHSM_CERT_C sc ON sc.STUDENTSDCID = st.DCID INNER JOIN PS_COMMON_CODE pcc ON pcc.CODE = sc.CERTTYPE AND pcc.PS_GROUP LIKE cfg.cert_group_pattern LEFT JOIN S_ON_STU_X x ON x.STUDENTSDCID = st.DCID WHERE st.ENROLL_STATUS IN (0, -1) AND (cfg.school_ids IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || REPLACE(cfg.school_ids, ' ', '') || ',', ',' || st.SCHOOLID || ',') > 0) AND (cfg.exclude_brd_res_9 = 0 OR NVL(TO_CHAR(x.BRD_RES_STATUS), 'x') <> '9') AND (cfg.exclude_future_entries = 0 OR st.ENTRYDATE <= SYSDATE) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SPENROLLMENTS sp INNER JOIN GEN g ON g.ID = sp.PROGRAMID AND g.CAT = 'specprog' AND g.NAME LIKE cfg.program_name_pattern LEFT JOIN S_ON_SEN_X spx ON spx.SPENROLLMENTSDCID = sp.DCID WHERE sp.STUDENTID = st.ID AND (sp.EXIT_DATE IS NULL OR sp.EXIT_DATE = TO_DATE('1900-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') OR sp.EXIT_DATE > SYSDATE OR (spx.SHSM_PROGRAM_DATE IS NOT NULL AND spx.SHSM_PROGRAM_DATE <> TO_DATE('1900-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) ) ORDER BY a_StudentID, c_DateCompleted
